ai.title: An AI manager, an outage, an AI guardian

steps.title: The investor's rules, locked
steps.detail: A NEAR judge with the mandate: 1x leverage on liquidation value, a 12 USD floor, and exit if the manager is silent for 10 minutes. Then its only key is deleted: nobody, including us, can change it.

steps.title: An AI manager with a key that can only propose
steps.detail: Claude manages the strategy through a NEAR function-call key that can call propose_order and heartbeat on the judge, and nothing else.

steps.title: 13 attempts to cheat, all refused
steps.detail: Strangers proposing, triggering the investor's exit or faking heartbeats; the AI's key reaching for the exit; a guardian's evidence taken by another; a forged snapshot claiming 1,000,000 USD that NEAR's Read MPC refused to confirm.

steps.title: The AI trades, within its rules
steps.detail: Claude bought 0.0099 ETH; the judge signed it and Hyperliquid filled it 53 blocks later.
steps.quote: The mark is about 2.4% below the oracle and hourly funding is strongly negative, so a long collects funding… sized to keep leverage just under 1.0x.

steps.title: Then holds, on its own
steps.detail: Twice, Claude declined to add risk.
steps.quote: Leverage is already about 0.99x, so any buy would breach the 1.0x cap.

steps.title: A trade past the limit is refused
steps.detail: An order taking leverage to about 1.5x, sent with the AI's own key, so the result does not depend on what the AI decides.

steps.title: The manager goes silent
steps.detail: We stopped its heartbeats on purpose. Ten minutes later the judge itself reports the trigger the investor chose: manager-silent.

steps.title: An AI guardian waits, then acts
steps.detail: A second Claude, with no special key, watches. At 53 seconds past the window it declines; when the silence persists it acts.
steps.quote: The investor's own silence trigger has fired and the judge has verified it… Rescuing now returns the assets while the cushion is large.

steps.title: Both legs move, at once
steps.detail: The judge signs a reduce-only close on Hyperliquid and a vault exit on Base. The close fills; the vault sends 0.006 WETH straight to the investor.

steps.title: The USDC is swept home
steps.detail: Flat, so the judge signs a sweep of everything left on the Hyperliquid account to the investor's fixed address.

steps.title: Paid only when it arrived: 7.887 USDC
steps.detail: A fresh snapshot shows the account empty and the investor's balance up by what it held. Only then is the guardian paid 0.5 NEAR.

steps.title: Paid only when it arrived: 0.006 WETH
steps.detail: After Base finality, NEAR's Read MPC confirms the vault's receipt. The guardian is paid 0.3 NEAR. Done.

steps.title: And nothing twice
steps.detail: Settling again, confirming the same receipt, a second rescue, the AI trading after the exit: all refused.

human.title: The investor's own exit, a guardian by hand

steps.title: No manager: the investor's own exit
steps.detail: A second locked judge, with 2 USDC on Hyperliquid and 0.002 WETH on Base.

steps.title: The investor asks to leave
steps.detail: Only the investor's NEAR account can do this, at any time, for any reason. It cannot redirect a cent.

steps.title: A person runs the rescue by hand
steps.detail: One command at a time: the guardian opens the rescue, relays the vault exit and the sweep.

steps.title: Both legs home, each paid once
steps.detail: The investor's Hyperliquid USDC goes 898.0 → 900.0 and the vault's WETH reaches the investor; each leg's reward is paid only after its arrival is proven.
